scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:worker" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${API_PORT:-8000}
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run taskiq worker app.worker.broker:broker app.worker.tasks
